label: ACCEPT
reason: Every icon in src/icons (REST-api.ts, sentry.ts, datadog.ts, plus a grep of all files) passes a third svgDefaults arg with fill to the default export of createSupabaseIcon.ts (declared as createLucideIcon, hence clear: false); svgDefaults is optional so tsc does not catch omission, and the only listed exemption, defaultAttributes.ts, is the defaults object itself (one_off). With nothing left to count, the simplest violation is worth flagging: defaultAttributes sets fill 'none', so a fill-only icon (stroke 'none', like datadog.ts/sentry.ts) without fill renders blank, and validateIcons.mjs shows the team wants fill declared explicitly; hesitated with WRONG incidental because for stroke icons the passed fill 'none' duplicates the default and is just copied by exportTemplate.mjs.
